items.description: A free, open-source website template for Astro and Tailwind CSS: pages, widgets, a blog, SEO and image optimisation, ready to customise.
Developers, studios and small teams who want a fast, well-structured site without designing every section from scratch: startups, SaaS, portfolios, marketing sites, blogs.
Node.js 22.22 or newer, a code editor and about ten minutes. No account, no licence key.

items.title: Create the project
items.description: Run `npm create astro@latest -- --template arthelokyo/astrowind`, then `npm install` and `npm run dev`.

items.title: Make it yours
items.description: Name, URL and metadata in one config file; colours and fonts in one styles file; replace the logo.

items.title: Build and deploy

props.title: Questions buyers ask about a product page
props.subtitle: Answered here so nobody has to write in.

items.title: What is a product details landing page?
items.description: A page dedicated to one product or service, structured in layers: a one-line summary, the main benefits, the full specifications, and everything a buyer needs to decide (price, availability, proof, common questions). It replaces the back-and-forth of a sales conversation.

items.title: How is it different from a sales page or a click-through page?
items.description: A sales page argues; a click-through page bridges; a product page informs. Its visitor already wants this kind of thing and is comparing. Completeness and clarity convert here, not persuasion.

items.title: How much detail is too much on a product page?
items.description: None, if it is organised by depth. Keep the first two screens skimmable and let the specifications carry the detail. Nobody leaves because a spec table is long; they leave because the first screen was vague.

items.title: Where do price and availability go?
items.description: Near the top for a known product, after the features for a new one. Either way on the page itself — “contact us for pricing” is a form in disguise and costs conversions.

items.title: What images does a product page need?
items.description: At least one of the product in use, not only on white. Screenshots for software, context shots for physical goods, a short demo clip if it moves.

items.title: Can I use it for client work?
items.description: Yes — MIT, no attribution required, unlimited sites. Studios shipping it under their own brand is the most common use.

items.title: How do I adapt this page with AstroWind?
items.description: Every block is a widget: Hero, Features, Table, Gallery, Steps, Testimonials, FAQs and CallToAction. Replace the copy and images, keep the three depths, and point the buttons at your store or checkout.
